COOKIE SETTINGS

Last updated: September 1, 2026

This page explains how Zoorzio uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and remember information about your visit.

1. Why we use cookies

We use cookies for purposes such as:

  • Strictly necessary: to enable core site functions (security, load balancing, language preferences).
  • Preferences: to remember choices you make (e.g., language or UI preferences).
  • Analytics: to understand how the site is used and improve performance.
  • Marketing (if enabled): to measure campaigns and show relevant content.

2. Managing cookies

You can control cookies in two ways:

  • Through this Cookie Settings page (where available)
  • Through your browser or device settings (you can block or delete cookies)

Please note: Blocking some cookies may cause parts of the site to stop working.

3. Do Not Track

Some browsers offer a “Do Not Track” (DNT) signal. Because there is no consistent industry standard for responding to DNT signals, we do not currently respond to DNT.
